studies.title: The Mamluk post and its pigeons
studies.caption: Sultan Baybars rebuilds the barid, the state post, with relays of horses and lofts of carrier pigeons flying messages between Cairo, Damascus and the frontier.
studies.prompt: Close view of a Mamluk pigeon keeper's hands gently holding a natural grey homing pigeon beside a small rolled message being attached to its leg, on a Cairo rooftop around1270. Low pigeon-loft openings and restrained medieval Cairo roofscape recede into soft wash. Simple long tunic and wrapped headcloth, no foreground sultan. Tiny paper note, no oversized scroll, modern plastic leg band or later Ottoman skyline.
